## Où j'en suis
Built `cmd/replay` in ingest to re-ingest the 12/11 (14:10–17:40 UTC) lost events from the raw S3 archive: per-partition-ordered reader, dedup check, batch producer hard-allowlisted to `events.replay.v3`, and rejects file for malformed lines. Dry run completed: 18,442,107 events to replay, 0 already in dedup store, 3,118 schema v2 lines written to `s3://kestrel-raw-events/replay-rejects/2026-11-12/`. PR opened with dry-run numbers and run plan, waiting on Daniel's review.

- [en-cours] PR kestrel-analytics/ingest#233 open, awaiting Daniel's review before the real replay
- [prochaine-étape] After review approval: run the real replay into `events.replay.v3`, then aggregator `--backfill` for 2026-11-12
- [prochaine-étape] Give Rachel an ETA for Fernhill and Orbitly (needed by Friday) — only after Daniel's review
- [essai-raté] First dry run job `replay-dryrun-1` OOMKilled at `--batch 50000` with 4 workers (~2.6 GiB peak > 2 GiB limit); fixed by reducing batch to 5k (~310 MiB peak), memory limit left untouched per namespace quota
- [essai-raté] TestStreamWindow_OrderWithinPartition failed initially: 4 parallel workers interleaved events of the same partition out of order; fixed by splitting workers by partition key (commit 4e2d9b7)
- [décision] Replay the entire window with no age cutoff, into a separate topic `events.replay.v3` only, never directly to `events.v3` (source: t05)
- [décision] Batch size 5k instead of raising the job memory limit (source: t13)
- [décision] Malformed lines are written to a rejects file in the bucket instead of being skipped silently (source: t15)
- [décision] No draft reply to Rachel; the user gives the ETA personally after Daniel's review (source: t19)
